visualCharacteristics: Full-bleed colored band split into an image half and a text half (heading, paragraph, optional bold subtext and CTA). Image sits left or right per option; background color (dark blue / teal) supplied by the section. Stacks image-over-text on mobile.
contentPattern: One row, two cells: image cell + text cell. Option class 'image-right' swaps sides.
usage: Vertical-market landing pages — alternating feature bands. Also reused on the homepage (/fr) 'Pourquoi Zurn?' full-bleed feature band.
